label: For "Sleeping Cell Detection": Detect cells that appear healthy to the alarm system but carry no traffic or serve users badly, so silent outages are found in minutes not days. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training only on alarmed cells.
